fields.name: Rede_Ensino

fields.name: Telefone

fields.name: Numero_Total_Campus

fields.name: NOME_CAMPUS

fields.name: Situacao

fields.name: MEDIA_MINIMA

fields.name: Numero_Inscricao

fields.name: Data_Nascimento

fields.name: Genero
fields.description: Candidate gender (synthetic, not present in source data)

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Candidate contact email (synthetic, not present in source data)

fields.name: Telefone

fields.name: UF_Residencia
fields.description: Candidate's state of residence (synthetic, not present in source data)

fields.name: Municipio_Residencia
fields.description: Candidate's city of residence (synthetic, not present in source data)

fields.name: Tipo_Escola_Origem

fields.name: CandidatoID
fields.description: References Candidato.ID

fields.name: CursoID
fields.description: References Curso.CODIGO_CURSO

fields.name: ANO
fields.description: Selection process year

fields.name: EDICAO
fields.description: Selection process edition within the year

fields.name: DS_ETAPA
fields.description: Selection stage (e.g., LISTA DE ESPERA)

fields.name: TIPO_MOD_CONCORRENCIA
fields.description: Competition modality type code

fields.name: MOD_CONCORRENCIA
fields.description: Competition modality description (e.g., Ampla concorrencia)

fields.name: PERCENTUAL_BONUS
fields.description: Bonus percentage applied to the candidate's score, when applicable

fields.name: OPCAO
fields.description: Preference order of this course choice for the candidate (1st or 2nd option)

fields.name: CLASSIFICACAO
fields.description: Candidate's ranking position on the waitlist for this course

fields.name: APROVADO
fields.description: Approval flag: S (approved) or N (not approved)

rules.name: candidate_option_limit
rules.description: Every candidate may register at most 2 course options (OPCAO) across all their Inscricao records

validation_logic.constraint: For each candidate, the number of distinct course options (OPCAO) must not exceed 2

fix_strategy.description: Re-extract application data from the document to fix option-count violations

rules.name: course_approval_capacity_limit
rules.description: Every course's approved-candidate capacity: COUNT(DISTINCT CandidatoID with APROVADO='S' per CursoID) <= 20

validation_logic.constraint: For each course, the number of approved candidates must not exceed 20

fix_strategy.description: Re-extract enrollment/approval data from the document to fix capacity violations
